title: Kenyan Pumpkin Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew originating from East Africa, made with tender pumpkin, aromatic spices, and a hint of sweetness.

ingredients.name: seeds
ingredients.notes: such as sesame or pumpkin seeds

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add ginger and garlic and cook for another minute.
Add pumpkin, tagine spice blend, and Kenyan. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add coconut milk and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the pumpkin is tender.
Stir in chopped seeds and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with additional seeds and a dollop of coconut milk, if desired.
